exceptions.rationale: This narrow pass-through chain does not authenticate or mutate state itself; it forwards the browser session and CSRF token to Identity, which validates both. The gateway's own authenticated BFF chain retains CSRF protection.

The browser reauthenticate=true parameter terminates session reuse by starting a fresh OAuth authorization flow; it never grants access or creates authentication. Reuse otherwise requires an OAuth2AuthenticationToken from the server security context, its stored authorized client, and Domain auth/me HTTP 200 using that client bearer and Gateway sign-in proof. Anonymous, missing-client and Domain-rejected sessions start OAuth. CloudGatewaySecurityIntegrationTest verifies these boundaries. Reviewed against the reported completed full scan; exact whole-source binding and expiry apply.
